scope: Pinned genuine FlowCompat + accounting + ServiceCompat no-outside-opening branch + real base close/revision bodies; synthetic event input. Trusted demo Admin bridge only.
interpretation: C05 assertion PASS reproduces an UNSAFE original behavior; original sequential close is not safe under final-write failure. C06-C08 verify bounded atomic proposal.
isolation: New independent local clone of exact official head; retained locked packages/tools/Java/JAR copied. Java21 SM and Node loopback guards, dummy HOME, official JAR checksum, both egress-denial preflights, Auth/Firestore Emulator, unchanged deny-write Rules. Initial sandbox loopback probe was blocked; guarded final run used approved execution outside OS sandbox.
recovery: Atomic failure leaves DB unchanged; fresh retry succeeds once. Sequential C05 has lost marker and missing reconciliation after committed close; replay does not repair. Existing marker requires review and is rejected without writes.
limitations: No real Auth/IAM proof or formal close API contract
No legacy writer migration, POS, production/staging, deployment or merge
Atomic adapter is bounded transaction buffering, not general Firebase Web SDK emulation
Concurrent close/void under new atomic wrapper and broader flow variants remain untested
